objective: Recommend an established maintained MCP-to-Pi tool adapter that reduces tool-schema context bloat, or establish why separate pi-mcp-to-tool is needed.
scope: Read-only research now; integration or new package belongs to0.3.4 after minimal0.3.3 npm release.

User requirement verbatim: if there is an mcp-to-pi-tool extension for adapting the context-bloat from mcp to actual pi tools, we should use it if it's well maintained and not obscure, if not we shall develop it as another package `pi-mcp-to-tool`.

Search public authoritative npm/GitHub/Pi package documentation for existing MCP bridges. Identify at most3 credible candidates, including lazy/discovery or codemode approaches where present. Distinguish actual Pi-native callable tools from merely stuffing all MCP schemas into context.

Evaluate maintenance with dated releases/recent substantive commits, documented compatibility with current Pi1.5.x, issue responsiveness, provenance/maintainer/community signals and architecture. Avoid invented popularity or arbitrary stars threshold. State supported OS/transports and credential handling as sourced facts or unknown.

Produce a concrete recommendation with reasons, integration concerns, and a small fallback package contract only if no maintained established option fits. Cite source URLs, exact versions and dates. No installation, source edits or account changes.
constraints: Do not read or expose tokens/auth files. No global changes, model calls, publish, messages or .holyagent edits. Preserve current installation.
Report at most8 bullets; at most3 candidates with evidence URLs; separate facts/inference/unknown. Long notes outside repo. End with exact criterion/evidence labels.

criteria.text: Actual context and Pi tool behavior
